summary.zh-CN: 逐位置前馈网络把同一个两层小网络独立应用到序列的每一个位置。它不读取其他位置，而是在每个位置内部扩张、非线性变换并重新压回隐藏维度。
summary.en-US: A position-wise feed-forward network applies the same small two-layer network independently to every position in a sequence. It does not read other positions; it expands, nonlinearly transforms, and projects each position back to the hidden dimension.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 所有位置共享同一套 FFN 参数，但各行独立计算；它改变特征，不负责跨位置交换信息。
coreConclusion.en-US: All positions share the same FFN parameters, but each row is computed independently. The FFN changes features; it does not exchange information across positions.
